svg.title: Twenty display modes
svg.desc: A grid of twenty miniature display modes, from big number and gauge to heatmaps, uptime ribbon, live table and hex grid.
svg.text: 20 WAYS TO SEE THE SAME FIELD
The picker renders your real data in every compatible mode side by side. Click the one you like.
Every mode labels state in text, uses tabular numbers, masks sensitive values and follows the animation level.
